source_title: My Home Delivery Expands On-Demand Big & Bulky Delivery to Charlotte, North Carolina - PR Newswire
source_excerpt:
New service offers a convenient way to arrange delivery for furniture, appliances, and other Big & Bulky purchases.
ENGLEWOOD, N.J. , Oct. 29, 2026 /PRNewswire/ -- My Home Delivery has expanded its on-demand delivery services to Charlotte, North Carolina, providing area residents and retailers with a convenient solution for transporting furniture, appliances, mattresses, large electronics, and other Big & Bulky purchases.
Through the My Home Delivery App, customers can arrange delivery for purchases that are too large to transport in a personal vehicle. Services include transportation, in-home placement, assembly, and item removal.
"Our expansion into Charlotte allows us to provide more customers with a simple and dependable way to bring Big & Bulky purchases home," said Arelis Bonilla, CEO and Founder of My Home Delivery. "Whether an item is purchased from a retailer or local marketplace, customers can arrange professional delivery directly through the app."
The Charlotte launch is part of My Home Delivery's continued expansion into new markets, making flexible delivery services available to more customers and retail partners.
Customers in the Charlotte service area can download the My Home Delivery App and schedule their Big & Bulky deliveries.
Retailers in need of an on-demand delivery solution, contact My Home Delivery at [email protected] .
